execution_constraints: Zero Python production code modification (src/**/*.py FROZEN)
Zero Blender execution (GUI and Headless strictly forbidden)
Zero test runner execution (pytest, unittest forbidden)
Zero formal architecture Markdown modification (ARCHITECTURE_SYNC.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, DECISIONS.md, PROJECT_STATE.md, AI_SYNC.md, HANDOFF.md, CHANGELOG.md, docs/**/*.md LOCKED)
Pure architecture revision output strictly confined to docs/evidence/PKG5_10B_REVISION_9/architecture_draft_candidate.json
Separation of architecture review from production implementation

prohibitions.no_name_inference: name(r) == expected_name does NOT imply Owned(r, t). Object or collection names in Blender are mutable strings and prone to external collision.
prohibitions.no_snapshot_diff_inference: r not in Snapshot does NOT imply Owned(r, t). Resources absent from initial snapshot may belong to external pipelines or user interactions; differential deletion is strictly prohibited.
prohibitions.no_raw_pointer_alone_inference: as_pointer(r) == saved_ptr does NOT imply AliveVerified(r). The underlying C allocator can reuse virtual addresses after memory destruction; pointer equality must be combined with active Python wrapper liveness (no ReferenceError) and data collection inclusion.

Object.ownership_criteria: Only objects registered upon creation in active_tx.created_controller_objects or doomed in active_tx.stashed_objects.
Object.mutation_authority: Only the active transaction in ACTIVE state is permitted to modify controller transforms.
Object.deletion_authority: Rollback permits deleting only active_tx.created_controller_objects with pointer matching. Post-commit cleanup permits deleting only stashed doomed objects.
Object.death_detection: ReferenceError on attribute access, pointer divergence, or absence from bpy.data.objects.

Constraint.ownership_criteria: Only constraints registered upon creation in active_tx.created_constraints or doomed in active_tx.stashed_constraints.
Constraint.mutation_authority: Only the active transaction in ACTIVE state is permitted to update influence, targets, or properties.
Constraint.deletion_authority: Rollback permits removing only active_tx.created_constraints matching registered bone and pointer. Post-commit cleanup permits removing stashed doomed constraints.
Constraint.death_detection: ReferenceError on access, pointer divergence, or absence from pose_bone.constraints.

Collection.ownership_criteria: Only collections created by active transaction and registered in active_tx.created_collections.
Collection.mutation_authority: Only active transaction in ACTIVE state is permitted to modify membership or parent links.
Collection.deletion_authority: Rollback permits deleting only registered created collections that contain zero external members.
Collection.death_detection: ReferenceError, pointer mismatch, or absence from bpy.data.collections.

DataBlock.ownership_criteria: Underlying data (Mesh, Curve) bound to Object entities, tracked by reference count.
DataBlock.deletion_authority: Post-commit cleanup permits removing data blocks only if owning doomed object is deleted AND user_count == 0. If user_count > 0, deletion is strictly forbidden.
DataBlock.death_detection: ReferenceError or absence from corresponding bpy.data collections.

external_relationship_conflict_policy.description: Handling scenario where a transaction-created entity is subsequently referenced by external systems.
policy_rules: Step 1: Verify entity's original ownership record in active_tx.
Step 2: Inspect all active live relationships (parenting, collection memberships, constraint targets, modifier targets).
Step 3: Distinguish relationships registered by this transaction from external relationships.
Step 4: If an external system has attached to the transaction-created entity and the external relationship cannot be safely undone, the transaction is FORBIDDEN from destroying the entity blindly.
Step 5: Rollback must halt, flag OWNERSHIP_CONFLICT, leave the entity intact, and report recovery failure to prevent cascading destruction of external scene graph.

unknown_ownership_policy.behavior: Any entity or relationship whose provenance cannot be proven to belong to the active transaction and was not recorded in baseline snapshot is treated as OWNERSHIP_UNPROVEN. Destructive operations (delete, unlink, overwrite) are strictly rejected. Rollback halts with an explicit warning.

PRE_EXISTING_ORIGINAL.description: Relationships that existed prior to transaction entry (e.g., character collection already linked to master/scene collection, pre-existing bone constraints).
PRE_EXISTING_ORIGINAL.rollback_rule: Strictly protected. If the transaction executes a duplicate link or re-bind, it NEVER acquires revocation or unlinking rights. Original links must remain intact upon rollback.

TX_ADDED.description: Relationships newly established by the active transaction (e.g. newly created controller linked to Character collection).
TX_ADDED.rollback_rule: Subject to rollback. Reverted by unlinking or removal upon rollback ONLY IF supported by authorized PREPARE record and proven causal evidence.

TX_UNLINKED_ORIGINAL.description: Pre-existing original relationships explicitly detached or unlinked by the transaction during business execution.
TX_UNLINKED_ORIGINAL.rollback_rule: Must be re-linked / restored to original state during rollback, preserving original target and relative ordering.

EXTERNAL_ADDED.description: Relationships created by external scripts, operators, or user interaction during or after transaction start.
EXTERNAL_ADDED.rollback_rule: Strictly immune to rollback destruction. Transaction is FORBIDDEN from unlinking or deleting external relationships.

OWNERSHIP_UNKNOWN.description: Relationships whose origin, authorization, or causal history cannot be conclusively proven.
OWNERSHIP_UNKNOWN.rollback_rule: Treated as OWNERSHIP_UNPROVEN. Rollback halts, leaves relationship untouched, records RECOVERY_UNCERTAIN in log, and reports verification failure.

f1_relationship_atomicity.operation_log_state_notes: These 5 states are relationship operation log states tracked inside active_tx.prepared_relationship_mutations, NOT transaction lifecycle states. The transaction lifecycle remains strictly composed of 9 states.

formal_rollback_principle.theorem: Undo(m) <=> TxAuthorized(m, t) and PreparedRecordExists(m, t) and IdentityValid(src(m), dst(m)) and CausalEvidenceProven(m) and not ExternalHarmRisk(m)
axioms: 1. Active Transaction Authorization: Mutation m must have been explicitly authorized under the active transaction context t.
2. Prepare Record Existence: A valid PREPARED log entry must exist in active_tx.prepared_relationship_mutations before any Blender C-API mutation was executed.
3. Valid Resource Identity: Source and destination RNA entities must remain alive and pointer-verified (no stale pointer reuse, no ReferenceError).

4. Causal Evidence Proven: Physical inspection of live scene topology must prove the observed relationship modification was directly produced by this transaction operation, not pre-existing or externally injected.
5. Zero External Harm Risk: Undoing the relationship mutation must carry zero risk of breaking external scene graph dependencies.
6. Incomplete CONFIRM does NOT imply mutation did not occur: If an exception occurs after C-API linkage but before CONFIRMED registration, live state must be inspected against PREPARE record.

7. APPLY exception does NOT guarantee zero side effects: A Blender C-API failure during link/parenting may have partially applied in C-memory before failing Python wrapper; rollback must verify actual physical state.
8. Prohibition of Name or Differential Inference: Relationship ownership cannot be inferred from object names or snapshot set difference.
9. Duplicate Link No Revocation: For PRE_EXISTING_ORIGINAL, repeated link operations cannot claim ownership or deletion rights.
10. Site Preservation on Uncertainty: For unprovable changes, preserve scene site, set log to RECOVERY_UNCERTAIN, and abort destructive rollback.

phase_prepare.description: Pre-flight and register intent before mutating Blender relationship state.
actions: Verify identity of source and target entities (ReferenceError and pointer check).
Verify mutation authorization under current transaction context.
Check whether relationship already exists in live scene; categorize as PRE_EXISTING_ORIGINAL if present.
Record mutation intent in active_tx.prepared_relationship_mutations with unique op_id, source pointer, target pointer, and category.
Log status set to PREPARED in transaction memory before touching Blender C-API.
phase_prepare.on_failure: If preparation fails, ZERO Blender relationships are modified. Abort immediately.

phase_apply.description: Execute authorized relationship mutation in Blender C-API and verify immediate live effect.
actions: Execute specific relationship API (col.objects.link, col.children.link, obj.parent = ..., con.target = ...).
Inspect RNA structure immediately post-call to verify link/mutation took effect in C-data.
phase_apply.on_exception: DO NOT assume mutation did not occur. Query actual live relationship state against PREPARED record. If partial modification is detected, mark for rollback based on PREPARED record; if state is indeterminate, mark RECOVERY_UNCERTAIN.

phase_confirm.description: Verify post-mutation state and mark operation confirmed in transaction memory.
actions: Confirm live topology matches expected target relationship.
Mark mutation record in active_tx as CONFIRMED.

phase_failure_recovery.description: Rollback behavior when apply, confirm, or subsequent business operations fail.
rules: Rollback evaluates PREPARED record and live physical state, NEVER relying solely on CONFIRMED status.
Never delete substitute objects by name.
Never undo unknown relationships based on snapshot diff.
Only undo mutations that satisfy the formal rollback theorem: TxAuthorized and PreparedRecordExists and IdentityValid and CausalEvidenceProven and not ExternalHarmRisk.
If original relationship was PRE_EXISTING_ORIGINAL, duplicate link does NOT grant unlinking/deletion rights.
If actual relationship state cannot be verified (e.g. corrupt RNA pointer, external interference), set status to RECOVERY_UNCERTAIN, preserve scene site, and report recovery failure.

Layer1_TransactionCoordinator.name: Transaction Coordinator
callers: Layer 4 Business Functions (setup_arm_ik, set_hand_ik_target, set_arm_ik_influence, reset_arm_ik)
callees: Layer 2 (gate check, state update, failed isolation registration)
allowed_writes: Instructing Layer 2 to record persistent FAILED isolation
Layer1_TransactionCoordinator.exception_propagation: Intercepts business exceptions; triggers Layer 5 rollback; distinguishes pre-commit vs post-commit errors; chains compound errors on rollback verification failure; instructs Layer 2 to record FAILED isolation.
Layer1_TransactionCoordinator.rollback_responsibility: Coordinates rollback execution via Layer 5; does not execute direct resource deletion itself.

Layer2_StateOwnershipRegistry.name: State & Ownership Registry
Layer2_StateOwnershipRegistry.input: Entity references, pointers, mutation intent records, isolation tokens
Layer2_StateOwnershipRegistry.output: Ownership records, stashed records, pending cleanup lists, failure isolation records
Layer2_StateOwnershipRegistry.state_owner: Transaction memory records (created_*, stashed_*, prepared_mutations), Global _PENDING_ARM_RIG_CLEANUPS, Global _ISOLATED_FAILED_ARMATURES
forbidden_dependencies: Layer 1 (Registry never makes calls to Coordinator)
allowed_writes: Internal record lists, sets, and dictionary indices
Lifecycle state attribute ONLY upon Layer 1 Coordinator instruction
Quarantined failure isolation index ONLY upon Layer 1 Coordinator instruction
Layer2_StateOwnershipRegistry.exception_propagation: Raises RuntimeError on duplicate registration or illegal state transition instruction.
Layer2_StateOwnershipRegistry.rollback_responsibility: Pure state container; holds ownership evidence and isolation records for Layer 5/6.

Layer3_AuthorizedResourceOperations.name: Authorized Resource Operations
Layer3_AuthorizedResourceOperations.input: Explicit authorized parameters from Layer 4, Layer 5, or Layer 6
allowed_writes: Atomic Blender entity creation, deletion, linking, unlinking, renaming as authorized
forbidden_writes: Exposing created entities before Layer 2 registration
Layer3_AuthorizedResourceOperations.exception_propagation: Catches ReferenceError and wraps in descriptive operational RuntimeError; passes up to caller.
Layer3_AuthorizedResourceOperations.rollback_responsibility: Executes single authorized deletion/unlink when called by Layer 5.

Layer4_ArmIKBusinessOperations.name: Arm IK Business Operations
Layer4_ArmIKBusinessOperations.input: Target coordinates, side, rotation, influence, armature object
Layer4_ArmIKBusinessOperations.output: IK solution dictionary, controller dictionary, reachable status
Layer4_ArmIKBusinessOperations.state_owner: None in Python; business state persisted in scene bone transforms and constraints
allowed_writes: Controller world/local TRS within active transaction
forbidden_writes: Any scene write during Phase A/B preflight (Zero Mutation Guarantee)
Unprotected scene mutations outside Layer 1 transaction
Layer4_ArmIKBusinessOperations.exception_propagation: Raises TypeError/ValueError on preflight rejection; lets internal transaction exceptions propagate to caller; reports nested failure via rollback_only.
Layer4_ArmIKBusinessOperations.rollback_responsibility: None; relies entirely on Layer 1 transaction wrapper.

Layer5_SnapshotRestoreVerification.name: Snapshot / Restore / Verification
Layer5_SnapshotRestoreVerification.input: Armature object, snapshot dictionary, active_tx context
Layer5_SnapshotRestoreVerification.output: Immutable snapshot dictionary, diff list or verification success
allowed_writes: During rollback: restoring original bone transforms, constraint properties, controller parent inverses
Invoking Layer 3 to unlink transaction-created links and delete transaction-created entities
Layer5_SnapshotRestoreVerification.exception_propagation: Raises RuntimeError on snapshot read failure or verification mismatch diff > 1e-5.
Layer5_SnapshotRestoreVerification.rollback_responsibility: Full responsibility for executing rollback restoring baseline state.

Layer6_CommitCleanup.name: Commit & Cleanup
Layer6_CommitCleanup.input: Active transaction context in COMMITTED state, stashed resource queues
Layer6_CommitCleanup.output: Cleanup outcome enum: CLEANUP_SUCCESS, CLEANUP_INCOMPLETE, CLEANUP_FAILED (as RESULT data flow)
Layer6_CommitCleanup.state_owner: Stashed record cleaned progress flags (obj_cleaned, data_cleaned)
forbidden_dependencies: Layer 1 (Layer 6 NEVER makes calls to Coordinator)
allowed_writes: Invoking Layer 3 to delete doomed objects, constraints, and unreferenced data blocks (users == 0)
Layer6_CommitCleanup.exception_propagation: Aggregates cleanup failure errors; returns CLEANUP_INCOMPLETE or CLEANUP_FAILED to Layer 1 via function return value.
Layer6_CommitCleanup.rollback_responsibility: No rollback capability; responsible only for post-commit garbage collection convergence.

taxonomy.CALL: Downward invocation dependency where a higher layer calls a function in a lower layer. Participates in DAG topological sorting.
taxonomy.RESULT: Upward operation outcome returned via function return value along the Python call stack. Does NOT represent an invocation dependency and does NOT participate in DAG topological sorting.
taxonomy.STATE_READ: Read-only query of passive data structures in Layer 2 Registry.
taxonomy.STATE_WRITE: Authorized update of records or state attributes in Layer 2 Registry directed by Layer 1 Coordinator.

f2_directed_dependency_graph.cycle_elimination_proof: The dependency graph of invocation calls (CALL edges) is a strict Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG). Topological Order: Layer 4 -> Layer 1 -> Layer 5 -> Layer 6 -> Layer 3 -> Layer 2. Layer 2 is a pure passive store with zero outgoing call dependencies. Layer 6 is an operational executor with zero call dependencies on Layer 1. Operation results (CleanupOutcome, VerificationResult, GateResult) flow upward strictly as function return values on the Python stack (RESULT data flow), NOT as reverse invocations, and therefore do not participate in DAG topological sorting. Layer 6 cannot independently modify transaction lifecycle state.

f2_state_transition_authority.sole_authority: Layer 1 Transaction Coordinator is the SOLE decision maker for all lifecycle transitions.

CREATED.condition: Coordinator pushes transaction to stack or fails initialization.

SNAPSHOTTING.condition: Layer 5 completes read-only snapshot or snapshot read fails.

ACTIVE.condition: Business logic finishes without exception or catches runtime exception.

COMMITTING.condition: Phase 1 depsgraph update and commit prepare pass (crosses irreversible line) or fail.

COMMITTED.condition: Irreversible commit crossed. Ordinary rollback FORBIDDEN. If Layer 6 returns CLEANUP_INCOMPLETE or CLEANUP_FAILED, Coordinator transitions state to CLEANUP_PENDING.

ROLLING_BACK.condition: Layer 5 rollback and verification succeed 100% (ROLLED_BACK) or verification detects diff/error (FAILED).

ROLLED_BACK.condition: Terminal state for aborted transaction. Coordinator re-raises original business exception.

CLEANUP_PENDING.condition: Registered in global _PENDING_ARM_RIG_CLEANUPS. Blocks new writes on same armature. Transitions to COMMITTED only when Layer 6 retry_cleanup returns CLEANUP_SUCCESS.

FAILED.condition: Fatal terminal state. Recovery unproven. Scene potentially contaminated. Coordinator instructs Layer 2 to persist armature failure quarantine in _ISOLATED_FAILED_ARMATURES. Writing blocked. Re-entry rejected.

f2_state_transition_authority.retry_cleanup_flow: External Retry Request -> Layer 1 Coordinator (CALL) -> Layer 6 Cleanup Engine (CALL) -> Layer 3 Resource Ops (CALL) -> Layer 6 returns CleanupOutcome (RESULT) -> Layer 1 Coordinator updates State -> Layer 2 Registry (STATE_WRITE)

nested_transaction_rollback_only_contrac.description: Handling nested transactions on the same Armature.
contract_rules: 1. Inner transaction invocation reuses outer transaction context (depth remains 1, single snapshot).
2. If an inner operation raises an exception or fails preflight, even if caught by caller business try/except blocks, it calls outer_tx.mark_rollback_only(reason).
3. When the outer block exits and attempts to commit, Layer 1 Coordinator checks tx.rollback_only.
4. If tx.rollback_only is True, normal commit is REJECTED; Coordinator forces transition to ROLLING_BACK.
5. Silent commit after inner failure is structurally impossible.

persistent_failed_protection.description: Persistent isolation mechanism for Armatures that enter FAILED state, preventing forgotten failures after transaction stack pops.
persistent_failed_protection.failure_registration_authority: Layer 1 Coordinator directs Layer 2 Registry to register failure isolation upon transitioning to FAILED.
persistent_failed_protection.registration_timing: Immediately upon Coordinator confirming transition to FAILED state (e.g. rollback verification diff, corrupted snapshot read, fatal unhandled error).
persistent_failed_protection.resource_identity: Armature persistent session identity: tuple of (arm.as_pointer(), arm.name, arm_uuid).
persistent_failed_protection.query_entry_point: Layer 1 queries Layer 2 admission gate via _assert_arm_rig_cleanup_gate(arm) and registry.query_isolation_status(armature_id).
persistent_failed_protection.admission_block_condition: If registry.is_isolated_failed(armature_id) is True, reject transaction admission immediately with RuntimeError('Armature [ID] is quarantined in FAILED state: recovery unproven. All write transactions rejected.'). Zero scene writes.
persistent_failed_protection.legal_deisolation_condition: Cannot be cleared automatically by retry_cleanup. Can only be cleared by explicit administrative call deisolate_failed_armature(arm, auth_token, verification_proof) after independent verification confirms 100% 0-diff baseline state.

distinction_from_cleanup_pending.CLEANUP_PENDING: Business logic committed, doomed garbage collection incomplete. Normal convergence via idempotent retry_pending_arm_rig_cleanup() permitted.
distinction_from_cleanup_pending.FAILED: Recovery unproven, scene potentially contaminated. Normal retry strictly FORBIDDEN. Re-creation of original resources to spoof recovery strictly FORBIDDEN. FAILED cannot transition to COMMITTED.

persistent_failed_protection.armature_invalidation_handling: If the Armature object is destroyed externally in Blender, the quarantine tombstone record remains in _ISOLATED_FAILED_ARMATURES until session end to prevent newly allocated objects with recycled memory addresses from bypassing isolation.
persistent_failed_protection.isolation_scope: Quarantine is strictly scoped to the specific failed Armature. Independent Armatures in the same Blender session remain unblocked.

CONTRACT-01.name: Input Validation & Pre-Write Preflight
CONTRACT-01.invariant: All parameters (side, world_xyz, rotation, pole, influence, clamp_reach) and parent transform domains must be pre-validated before any scene mutation. Zero scene writes on rejection.
CONTRACT-01.failure_condition: Non-finite values, out-of-range influence, bad side string, or singular non-invertible parent matrix.
CONTRACT-01.exception_propagation: Immediate TypeError or ValueError; transaction is not entered.

CONTRACT-02.name: Same-Armature Nested Transaction & Failure Propagation
CONTRACT-02.invariant: Re-entrant transaction requests on same Armature reuse active context; stack depth remains 1; inner failure marks transaction rollback-only via explicit reporting path.
CONTRACT-02.failure_condition: Cross-armature nesting requested, or inner failure suppressed by caller.
CONTRACT-02.exception_propagation: Cross-armature raises RuntimeError; suppressed inner failure triggers forced rollback on outer commit.
CONTRACT-02.recovery_responsibility: Outermost Layer 1 Coordinator executes full rollback.

CONTRACT-03.name: Controller Creation & Ownership
CONTRACT-03.invariant: New controller Empty must be registered in active_tx immediately upon creation and before collection linkage. Rollback deletes strictly registered controllers.
CONTRACT-03.failure_condition: Creation failure, duplicate registration, or collection link failure.
CONTRACT-03.exception_propagation: Operational exception bubbles to Layer 1, triggering rollback.
CONTRACT-03.recovery_responsibility: Layer 5 deletes registered controller by pointer.

CONTRACT-04.name: Exception Atomicity of Resource & Relationship Mutation Registration
CONTRACT-04.invariant: All relationship mutations follow PREPARED -> APPLYING -> APPLIED_VERIFIED -> CONFIRMED log progression. Rollback is evidence-based (evaluates PREPARED record and live physical state), not solely checking CONFIRMED. Distinguishes 5 relationship categories. Duplicate link on PRE_EXISTING_ORIGINAL acquires zero revocation rights. Unproven mutations mark RECOVERY_UNCERTAIN and preserve site.
CONTRACT-04.failure_condition: RNA assignment failure, invalid collection link, RNA pointer corruption during apply, or unprovable relationship state.
CONTRACT-04.exception_propagation: Fails back to Layer 1 with precise operational context; sets RECOVERY_UNCERTAIN on unproven state.
CONTRACT-04.recovery_responsibility: Layer 5 inspects prepare/apply records and undoes only verified transaction mutations; preserves pre-existing and external links.

CONTRACT-05.name: Constraint Configuration, Identity & Restoration
CONTRACT-05.invariant: Constraint deletion is strictly identity-based. Transaction-created constraints are registered and deleted on rollback. External constraints are preserved with relative ordering intact.
CONTRACT-05.failure_condition: Constraint creation failure, same-name external collision, or destroyed original constraint.
CONTRACT-05.exception_propagation: Bubbles to Coordinator; verifier reports identity mismatch if original constraint destroyed.
CONTRACT-05.recovery_responsibility: Layer 5 deletes created constraints, restores original properties and relative ordering.

CONTRACT-06.name: Snapshot Integrity & Independence
CONTRACT-06.invariant: Snapshot captures deep immutable copies of all 4 controllers, 6 pose bones, constraints, and collection hierarchies with zero scene mutation.
CONTRACT-06.failure_condition: Unreadable property, missing bone, or view layer update failure during snapshotting.
CONTRACT-06.exception_propagation: Raises RuntimeError; Coordinator transitions directly to FAILED without rollback.

CONTRACT-07.name: Rollback & Verification Consistency + Persistent FAILED Quarantine
CONTRACT-07.invariant: Rollback restoration rules and post-rollback verification rules are strictly symmetric. Full-field comparison tolerance 1e-5. Discrepancy triggers transition to FAILED and immediate persistent registration in Layer 2 _ISOLATED_FAILED_ARMATURES, blocking future writes across transaction stack pops.
CONTRACT-07.failure_condition: Restoration fails to match snapshot, pointer identity changed, active transaction stack non-empty, or verification diff > 1e-5.
CONTRACT-07.exception_propagation: Aggregates differences, raises compound RuntimeError, registers persistent failure isolation.
CONTRACT-07.recovery_responsibility: Layer 1 marks state FAILED; Layer 2 records armature quarantine; writing blocked until authorized forensic de-isolation.

CONTRACT-08.name: Commit & Post-Commit Cleanup
CONTRACT-08.invariant: Commit crossing is irreversible. Ordinary rollback is forbidden after COMMITTED. Post-commit cleanup removes doomed resources and unreferenced data blocks (users == 0). Layer 6 returns outcome to Layer 1.
CONTRACT-08.failure_condition: Cleanup deletion fails due to locked datablock or Blender internal error.
CONTRACT-08.exception_propagation: Coordinator intercepts cleanup failure, transitions state to CLEANUP_PENDING, registers transaction.

CONTRACT-09.name: Admission Gate Query & Cleanup/Failure Protection
CONTRACT-09.invariant: Unidirectional query from Layer 1 to Layer 2 admission gate (_assert_arm_rig_cleanup_gate). Registry returns GateResult or raises rejection. Gate blocks writes if Armature has unresolved CLEANUP_PENDING or quarantined FAILED isolation. Independent Armatures proceed unblocked.
CONTRACT-09.failure_condition: Attempted write on Armature with unresolved CLEANUP_PENDING or active FAILED isolation.
CONTRACT-09.exception_propagation: Raises RuntimeError on write admission rejection; zero scene writes.
CONTRACT-09.recovery_responsibility: CLEANUP_PENDING requires retry_pending_arm_rig_cleanup; FAILED isolation requires explicit authorized de-isolation.

CONTRACT-10.name: WBC / Arm IK Cross-Module Interface
CONTRACT-10.invariant: WBC relies on Arm IK for single-frame reachability feedback and zero-side-effect exception safety. Arm IK exceptions signal frame planning failure to WBC.
CONTRACT-10.failure_condition: Arm IK raises exception or returns unreachable target.
CONTRACT-10.exception_propagation: Propagates to WBC frame step; WBC handles kinematic fallback or reports frame failure.
CONTRACT-10.recovery_responsibility: Arm IK ensures scene is 100% clean/rolled-back; WBC manages trajectory plan.

CONTRACT-11.name: Bilateral Reset Atomic Transaction
CONTRACT-11.invariant: reset_arm_ik executes dual-arm reset within unified transaction. Each side reset sequentially updates: (1) Hand Controller, (2) Elbow Pole, (3) PoseBones neutral rotations, (4) Constraint Influences to 0.0, (5) Prebend Hint. Preflight failure guarantees zero writes. Mid-reset write failure triggers bilateral rollback. Nested reset failure reports rollback_only = True to outer Coordinator.
CONTRACT-11.failure_condition: Parent transform preflight failure, controller write error, influence write error, prebend write error, or depsgraph update error.
CONTRACT-11.exception_propagation: Preflight raises ValueError; write error triggers complete bilateral rollback and re-raises; nested error sets outer rollback_only.
CONTRACT-11.recovery_responsibility: Layer 5 restores both Left and Right arms to pre-reset snapshot state.

CONTRACT-12.name: External Resource & Unknown Ownership Isolation
CONTRACT-12.invariant: External resources (unregistered entities or unknown relationships) are protected from accidental deletion or unlinking. Same-name collisions reject overwrite.
CONTRACT-12.failure_condition: External object occupies expected name, or unprovable relationship encountered.
CONTRACT-12.exception_propagation: Flags OWNERSHIP_UNPROVEN, rejects destructive action, reports recovery failure.
CONTRACT-12.recovery_responsibility: Halts rollback to protect external scene integrity.

f3_architecture_impact_matrix.failure_propagation: Raises ValueError/TypeError, aborts before transaction entry
Inner setup failure bubbles up, marks outer transaction rollback_only = True
Allocation failure aborts setup, bubbles to Layer 1
f3_architecture_impact_matrix.recovery_responsibility: Layer 5 deletes created controller by registered pointer

f3_architecture_impact_matrix.failure_propagation: Prepare failure aborts link operation with zero Blender modification
f3_architecture_impact_matrix.recovery_responsibility: Rollback evaluates PREPARED record and live physical state; unproven state sets RECOVERY_UNCERTAIN

f3_architecture_impact_matrix.failure_propagation: Constraint creation/config error bubbles to Layer 1, triggers rollback
f3_architecture_impact_matrix.recovery_responsibility: Layer 5 removes created constraints, restores original properties & order

f3_architecture_impact_matrix.failure_propagation: Snapshot failure transitions state to FAILED without rollback
f3_architecture_impact_matrix.recovery_responsibility: No rollback needed (scene was never mutated)

f3_architecture_impact_matrix.failure_propagation: Verification diff raises RuntimeError, marks state FAILED, registers armature in _ISOLATED_FAILED_ARMATURES

f4_reset_transaction_contract.architectural_position: Layer 4 Business API operating strictly within Layer 1 Transaction Coordinator.
core_invariants: Bilateral dual-arm atomicity: Left and Right arms belong to a single atomic transaction.
Zero-write preflight: Parent transform non-singularity verified before any scene write.
Unified snapshot: Baseline snapshot captured by Layer 1 covers both arms; no second snapshot.
Admission gate respect: Cannot execute writes if unresolved CLEANUP_PENDING or active FAILED isolation exists on Armature.
Five-component reset sequence per side: Hand Controller, Elbow Pole, PoseBones neutral rotations, Constraint Influences, Prebend Hint.
execution_sequence: 1. Transaction Admission Check: Layer 1 queries Layer 2 gate via _assert_arm_rig_cleanup_gate(arm) for CLEANUP_PENDING and FAILED quarantine.

2. Parent Transform Preflight: Call compute_effective_parent_matrix() and validate_effective_parent_transform() for HandIK and ElbowPole controllers on both L and R sides. If any fails, raise ValueError with ZERO business writes.
4. Baseline Snapshot: Layer 5 captures immutable snapshot of both arms, controllers, constraints.

5. Left Arm Reset Writes: Sequentially update (1) HandIK.L transform, (2) ElbowPole.L transform, (3) upper_arm.L/forearm.L/hand.L Euler rotations to neutral (0,0,0), (4) ArmIK.L and HandRotation.L influences to 0.0, (5) apply Left Prebend Hint. (Observable fault boundary: reset_arm_ik_after_influence_l).

6. Right Arm Reset Writes: Sequentially update (1) HandIK.R transform, (2) ElbowPole.R transform, (3) upper_arm.R/forearm.R/hand.R Euler rotations to neutral (0,0,0), (4) ArmIK.R and HandRotation.R influences to 0.0, (5) apply Right Prebend Hint. (Observable fault boundary: reset_arm_ik_after_influence_r).
7. Commit Preparation: Depsgraph synchronization via _depsgraph_update(). (Observable fault boundary: reset_arm_ik_during_depsgraph_update).
8. Logical Commit: Transition state to COMMITTED.
9. Post-Commit Cleanup: Trigger Layer 6 retry_cleanup() if any stashed resources exist.

rules: If reset_arm_ik is invoked inside an outer transaction on the same Armature, it reuses the outer context.
No early commit of the outer transaction is performed.
No independent post-commit cleanup is executed.
If reset_arm_ik fails during preflight or writes inside an outer transaction, it explicitly calls outer_tx.mark_rollback_only(reason).
Outer Coordinator checks tx.rollback_only at commit gate and rejects commit, forcing full rollback.
Preflight failure in nested reset raises ValueError without modifying scene, while guaranteeing outer transaction cannot silently commit.
If failure occurs during Phase 3 cleanup after logical commit, ordinary rollback is forbidden.
Subsequent writes on this Armature blocked until external retry_pending_arm_rig_cleanup succeeds.

f4_reset_state_graph.mermaid:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> ADMISSION_CHECK : reset_arm_ik(arm)
    
    state ADMISSION_CHECK {
        [*] --> GateAssert : _assert_arm_rig_cleanup_gate(arm)
        GateAssert --> PREFLIGHT : Gate Clear (No Pending Cleanup / No FAILED Quarantine)
        GateAssert --> BLOCKED : Unresolved CLEANUP_PENDING or Quarantined FAILED
    }
    
    BLOCKED --> [*] : Raise RuntimeError (Zero Writes)
    
    state PREFLIGHT {
        [*] --> ComputeMats : compute_effective_parent_matrix() for L/R
        ComputeMats --> ValidateConformal : validate_effective_parent_transform()
    }
    
    PREFLIGHT --> ABORT_PREFLIGHT : Invalid/Singular Matrix (det=0)
    ABORT_PREFLIGHT --> [*] : Raise ValueError (Zero Writes / mark outer rollback_only if nested)
    
    PREFLIGHT --> UNIFIED_TRANSACTION : Preflight 100% Valid
    
    state UNIFIED_TRANSACTION {
        [*] --> SNAPSHOTTING : Enter _arm_rig_transaction
        SNAPSHOTTING --> ACTIVE : Layer 5 Captures Dual-Arm Snapshot
        
        state ACTIVE {
            [*] --> LEFT_RESET : Start Dual-Arm Reset Sequence
            state LEFT_RESET {
                [*] --> L_HandPole : (1) HandIK.L & (2) ElbowPole.L Transforms
                L_HandPole --> L_Bones : (3) PoseBone Rotations to Neutral (0,0,0)
                L_Bones --> L_Influence : (4) ArmIK.L & HandRotation.L Influences to 0.0
                L_Influence --> L_Prebend : (5) Apply Left Prebend Hint
            }
            LEFT_RESET --> RIGHT_RESET : Left Arm Writes Complete (Fault Boundary: after_influence_l)
            state RIGHT_RESET {
                [*] --> R_HandPole : (1) HandIK.R & (2) ElbowPole.R Transforms
                R_HandPole --> R_Bones : (3) PoseBone Rotations to Neutral (0,0,0)
                R_Bones --> R_Influence : (4) ArmIK.R & HandRotation.R Influences to 0.0
                R_Influence --> R_Prebend : (5) Apply Right Prebend Hint
            }
            RIGHT_RESET --> [*] : Right Arm Writes Complete (Fault Boundary: after_influence_r)
        }
        
        ACTIVE --> COMMITTING : Dual-Arm Writes Complete
        COMMITTING --> COMMITTED : _depsgraph_update() Passes (Commit Line Crossed)
        
        ACTIVE --> ROLLING_BACK : Mid-write Failure (L or R) / Nested Error
        COMMITTING --> ROLLING_BACK : Depsgraph Update Failure
        
        state ROLLING_BACK {
            [*] --> BilateralRestore : Layer 5 Restores Dual-Arm Baseline State
            BilateralRestore --> VerifyMatch : Layer 5 Full-Field Verification (Tolerance 1e-5)
        }
        
        ROLLING_BACK --> ROLLED_BACK : Verification 100% Matches Snapshot
        ROLLING_BACK --> FAILED : Verification Mismatch / Restore Error
    }
    
    COMMITTED --> POST_COMMIT_CLEANUP : Phase 3 Cleanup Dispatch
    POST_COMMIT_CLEANUP --> [*] : Cleanup Success -> Neutral Rest Pose
    POST_COMMIT_CLEANUP --> CLEANUP_PENDING : Cleanup Fails -> Register Gate & Raise
    CLEANUP_PENDING --> [*]
    
    ROLLED_BACK --> [*] : Re-raise Original Business Error (Dual Arms Baseline Intact)
    FAILED --> [*] : Register Persistent Quarantine in Layer 2 & Raise Compound Fatal Error

DECISION-A.decision: Refuse overwrite, protect existing scene graph. Automatic renaming of external objects is strictly forbidden. Ownership conflicts halt rollback and raise explicit errors.
DECISION-A.rationale: Prevents data loss or scene hierarchy scrambling in multi-asset or user-edited production environments.

DECISION-B.decision: Scoped to single-armature atomicity. Cross-armature two-phase commit (2PC) is excluded from this phase. Upper pipeline must orchestrate multi-character resets sequentially.
DECISION-B.rationale: Avoids over-engineering complex distributed transaction protocols before single-armature integrity is certified.

DECISION-C.decision: Global bpy.data.orphans_purge() is strictly forbidden. Cleanup is restricted to explicitly authorized, identity-verified doomed objects where user_count == 0.
DECISION-C.rationale: Global orphan purging can destroy assets held by unlinked scenes, library overrides, or background staging caches.

unresolved_design_issues.topic: Depth of Isolation for Concurrent External Mutations
unresolved_design_issues.description: Blender's Python environment executes on the main thread, but modal timers, background depsgraph handlers, or scene drivers can mutate scene data concurrently. The current draft halts rollback with OWNERSHIP_UNPROVEN / RECOVERY_UNCERTAIN upon detecting external interference to preserve scene safety. Whether to introduce explicit scene locking, handler disabling, or driver evaluation suppression during transaction execution remains open for independent auditor review.

unresolved_design_issues.topic: Granularity of Relationship Mutation Rollback Logging
unresolved_design_issues.description: In PREPARED -> APPLYING -> APPLIED_VERIFIED -> CONFIRMED, recording individual RNA pointer pairs incurs slight memory overhead in Python. For standard arm IK (4 controllers, 4 constraints, 1 collection), the overhead is negligible (< 1 KB). If extended to dense whole-body rigs with hundreds of constraints, a compacted bitmask or identity hash index may be evaluated.
